# Mohetuzzaman Mobin

> Software engineer, AI agent consultant, and bassist. He builds software with AI agents and makes unnecessarily loud noises with four strings. Personal site styled as a Game Boy DMG cartridge. Built as a single self-contained static page (no server, no framework).

## Software development

- Web applications & backend systems
- APIs, integrations & automation
- Cloud infrastructure & deployments
- AI-powered applications
- Legacy systems

## Consulting

- Software architecture & technical decisions
- Backend systems and integrations
- AI adoption & agentic workflows
- Cloud infrastructure
- Making existing systems less painful

## Music

Bassist. Shohojia (first band), Urban Genesis (founding member). The Music page also plays an 8-bit (Web Audio square-wave) rendition of Vivaldi's Violin Concerto in A minor, RV 356, 1st movement — press A or the on-screen row; no audio files.
